annotation_method: Manual visual inspection of decoded RGB previews; no detector or model was run.
claim_boundary: IoU/recall evaluates class-agnostic RGB region coverage against a small, checksum-matched manual appearance-box set only. No automatic object detection, identity, segmentation, depth fusion, pose, or robot control is established.

evaluation.claim_boundary: 2D class-agnostic proposal overlap on the exact annotated frames only; not object detection, identity, segmentation, pose, or controller evidence.

proposal_set.confidence_semantics: no confidence or calibrated score; boxes are unranked class-agnostic proposals
